Commentary.Commentary: We are back for the run-chase! The England players make their way out. Followed by Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam. Adil Rashid to start with the ball. Here we go..

Right then! Pakistan need 201 to chase but is not going to be an easy one. England will look to remove the dangerous pair of Mohammad Rizwan and Babar Azam early. Don't go anywhere as this one is going to be a heck of a run chase.

Moeen Ali is down for a chat- He says it was nice to bat up the order. Informs that the wicket is good to bat. Says that they lost some wickets at the end but is happy with the score on the board. Ends by saying that they have Adil Rashid and they can bank on him to provide wickets.

Pakistan were punished brutally but came back towards the end! They started well as Imad got the big wicket of Roy in the very first over though he went for a few right away. Imad struck back again in his second over as he got Malan as well. They lost their rhythm a bit as Ali and Buttler were toying with them but the former departed courtesy to Mohammad Hasnain who put a full stop to Moeen Ali's innings. He struck back and got the dangerous Buttler who was looking to hit everything out of the park. Pakistan bowlers were not consistent with their lines and England batsman took advantage of it. After they got the dangerous Liam Livingstone, wickets fell at regular intervals. The bowlers conceded 47 runs in the last five overs but also scalped 5 wickets. England were 153-5 at the end of 14.5 overs and after that Pakistan ripped the tail-enders apart and managed to bundle them out for 200.

It was raining boundaries in Headingley! After Pakistan asked England to bat, Jason Roy started with some firecrackers but departed in the very first over. Malan too followed him next for a cheap score. After that, it was a roller-coaster of a powerplay as Moeen Ali and Jos Buttler joined forces and all of a sudden, boundaries were raining all over Headingley, and at the end of the Powerplay, England were 66/2. They stitched a partnership of 50 off just 24 balls. After that, Ali's cameo came to an end as he departed after scoring 36 off just 16 balls. Buttler was standing tall on the other side as he and Liam Livingstone formed a good partnership. Buttler seemed to be only dealing in boundaries and that cost his wicket as he departed back for a well-made 59. Liam Livingstone was keeping the tempo going making sure the run rate was well over 10. He got out in an unfortunate manner. Buttler and Moeen Ali's carnage with the help of Liam Livingstone has put 200 on the board.
OUT! BOWLED! A full ball on middle. Matt Parkinson again makes room for himself and looks to dig it out but fails to do it. The ball rolls and hits the stump. ENGLAND END AT 200.
FOUR! 200 up for England! A full ball outside off. Matt Parkinson makes room for himself and slashes it over point for a boundary.
Full ball on off. Saqib Mahmood drives it to mid off. The fielder there fumbles and allows a single.
LEG BYE! A length ball, around leg. Matt Parkinson moves across and looks to flick it but misses, gets hit on the pads. They take a leg bye as the ball rolls to the off side.
A length ball, angling down. Saqib tucks it to mid-wicket for a single.
Shaheen Afridi to bowl the final over.
Full ball on middle. Saqib Mahmood works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
A length ball outside off. Pushed to point for a single.
Matt Parkinson is the last batsman to walk in.

OUT! TIMBER! Haris Rauf gets his second wicket! Another one bites the dust for England! A yorker right on the middle stump. Rashid swivels across and looks to scoop it but fails to get any bat on it. The ball sneaks through and hits the stump. Hat-Trick ball coming up.
Saqib Mahmood walks out to bat.

OUT! CAUGHT! England are falling like a pack of cards! A full toss, on middle. Jordan heaves it towards deep mid-wicket. Shadab Khan there runs to his right, dives and takes a stunner to dismiss Chris Jordan. This wicket could make a difference of 10-20 runs.
Commentary.Howout: c Shadab Khan b Haris Rauf

Commentary.Commentary: Fuller length outside off. Rashid scoops it to short fine leg for another single.
A full ball, just around off. Rashid taps it to backward point.
Haris Rauf to bowl the penultimate over.
A good length ball on middle. Rashid comes across and flicks it to square leg for a single.
A slower short ball on middle. Pulled away to mid-wicket for one.
FOUR! Beautiful shot! A full ball, just around off. Jordan lofts it in between mid off and covers for a boundary.
A length ball outside off. Jordan cuts it past point for a couple of runs.
Adil Rashid is the new batsman in.

OUT! CAUGHT! Another one bites the dust and England are now 7 down. A length ball way outside off. Curran throws the kitchen sink at it. Does not get middle of the bat and hits it towards Sohaib Maqsood at deep cover who charges forward and takes a brilliant catch.
Commentary.Howout: c Sohaib Maqsood b Mohammad Hasnain

Commentary.Commentary: FOUR! Cracked away! A full ball on middle. Tom Curran whacks it towards square leg for a boundary.
SIX! Low full toss on middle, dipping in. Chris Jordan gets low and uses his wrists very well to deposit this over deep square leg. A maximum.
Fractionally short on off, Curran pulls it to long on this time for one.
Full and on the pads, Curran looks to flick but misses. The ball gets hit on the pads and rolls on the leg side. The batters are quick enough to come back for the second off the leg byes.
Short again on off, Curran slaps it towards deep mid-wicket. Shadab Khan does well to put a dive and stop the ball racing away. Gets a huge cheer from the crowds. Two taken.
Short and on off, Jordan pulls it towards square leg for one.
On a length on middle, Curran works it towards long on for a single.
Length delivery on off, Jordan eases it towards mid off.
Full and on off, pushed towards mid on.
On a length on off, Curran taps it towards point.
Chris Jordan is the new batsman in.

OUT! RUN OUT! Everything Is happening here! Tom Curran is the culprit! A full toss, way outside off. Liam Livingstone looks to scoop it but gets inner half of the bat towards square leg. He was not aware where the ball lobbed up. Curran at the other end calls for a quick sun. Azam Khan at square leg grabs the ball and throws it to the bowler's end. Haris Rauf collects the ball and clips the bails off with back on the stumps. Liam Livingstone made a full length dive but was short of his crease.

A  run out appeal has been taken upstairs. Liam Livingstone is short of the crease. Haris Rauf has disturbed the bails before grabbing the ball. But there was a bail hanging on the stumps and it was enough for the umpire to give the batsman out. An unfortunate way to get out but Liam Livingstone will walk back.
FOUR! That went like a rocket! Full again on off, Liam Livingstone is in the form of his life. He lifts it towards long off for a boundary.
Haris Rauf is back into the attack.

SIX! MASSIVE! Touch fuller on off, Liam Livingstone slaps it over long on for a maximum. That has gone over the ropes. The commentators in the air say they have never ever watched a ball clear such distance. Not the first time Liam Livingstone has lost a ball today.
Tossed up around off, Livingstone chips it towards covers for a run.
Who will walk out to bat now? It is Tom Curran.

OUT! TAKEN! Pakistan gets a little breathing space here! Tossed up on off, Johny Bairstow connects it this time. But doesn't hit it right out of the middle. The ball goes high up in the air towards long off. Fakhar Zaman completes the catch. He won't drop those. Jonny Bairstow has to depart and Shadab Khan provides a crucial breakthrough.
Commentary.Howout: c Fakhar Zaman b Shadab Khan

Commentary.Commentary: Play and a miss! Loopy ball outside off, Bairstow looks to heave it away but misses.
Excellent running between the wickets! Short and on middle, Bairstow knocks it towards long on for a couple of runs.
Outside off, knocked in front of backward point for a single.
Beaten! Tossed up nicely on off, spinning away. Livingstone looks to cut but gets beaten on the outside edge.
Shadab Khan is back into the attack.
Full and on middle, Bairstow whips it towards deep mid-wicket for a brace. 150 up for England.

NO BALL AND FOUR! Full toss above waist on middle, Jonny Bairstow gets into the position and pulls it towards deep square leg for another boundary. Mohammad Hasnain has overstepped and will have to reload again. Free Hit coming up...
FOUR! Bairstow doesn't waste time! Length ball on off, Jonny Bairstow cuts it past point and third man for a boundary.
Full and on middle, worked towards long on for a single.
Good length ball on off, Bairstow drives it towards covers. He is off the mark with a single.
Who will walk out to bat now? It is Jonny Bairstow.

OUT! CAUGHT! Little bit full on off, Jos Buttler slams it very hard towards mid off. He wanted to clear mid off but doesn't get the elevation. Babar Azam watches the ball closely and completes the catch. He runs back and loses his balance too after grabbing it as it was hit that hard. Nevertheless, End of an excellent knock by Jos Buttler. He has done the damage already.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Mohammad Hasnain

Commentary.Commentary: Touch fuller on off, Liam Livingstone whacks it towards deep mid-wicket. The fielder there does well to stop it on one bounce. A run taken.
SIX! Buttler-assault continues! Short and outside off, Jos Buttler this time rocks back and deposits it over deep extra cover for a biggie. 15 runs from the over.
Short and outside off, Buttler plays it towards covers.
Flatter and quicker onto the stumps, Buttler defends it back to the bowler.
Tossed up on middle, flicked towards deep square leg for a brace.
Full and on off, Livingstone strides forward and knocks it to mid-wicket for one.
SIX! Sweet! Tossed up on off, Liam Livingstone shimmies down the track and smacks it over long off for a huge maximum. That went out of the stadium. A new ball has been brought in.
Short ball way outside off. Liam reaches to it and cuts it to sweeper cover for a single.
Darted on the pads, flicked away to square leg for a single.
Fuller ball outside off. Liam Livingstone goes for the reverse sweep and finds short third man. Single taken.
WIDE! Third extra of the over! Spills it way outside off. Left alone from Liam. Wided.
This time sprays it just inside the tramline. Liam Livingstone leaves it alone.
WIDE! Another one way outside off. Left alone. Wided.
WIDE! Sprays it way outside off. Left alone. Wided.
FOUR! Well played! Full ball on middle. Liam Livingstone lofts it over the bowler's head for a boundary.
On middle, eased down to long on for a single. 50 up for Jos Buttler. 14th T20I fifty for Buttler. Terrific innings this! He would look to continue the same.
Shadab Khan is back on. Conceded 18 in his first two overs.
Darted on the pads, flicked to square leg for a single. Good over from Imad Wasim, just 5 from it.
Another short ball on middle. Liam Livingstone works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed up outside off. Liam Livingstone slaps it through point towards sweeper cover for a brace.
Another short ball outside off. Liam Livingstone missed out there as he slaps it straight to covers.
Fuller ball outside off. Liam Livingstone pushes it to mid off.
Short ball outside off. Buttler eases it to point. Moves to 48.
Imad Wasim is back into the attack.
Just missed out there! A full toss on middle. Liam Livingstone works it to mid-wicket.
SIX! Magnificient! 100 up for England! A length ball outside off. Liam Livingstone gets low and smashes it over long on for a biggie.
Yorker on middle. Buttler jams it out to deep mid-wicket for a single. The fielder in the deep fumbles but no harm done.
FOUR! Cracked away! A back of a length ball on middle. Buttler stands tall and pulls it to square leg for another boundary.
Full on middle. Buttler tucks it to mid on.
FOUR! Haris Rauf continues to leak runs! On the pads, Buttler flicks it in between the square leg and mid-wicket for a boundary.
Single to end the over! Flatter ball around off. Buttler pushes it to sweeper cover for a single.
Short ball around off. Buttler cuts it to point. There was a slight fumble but the batters decide not to take the single.
Full and outside off. Liam drives it to long off for a single.
Flatter ball outside off. Liam Livingstone pushes it to covers.
Just a single as this is eased down to mid-wicket.
Pitches it up, on middle. Buttler drives it but straight to covers.
Full ball on middle. Buttler eases it down to long on for a single.
On middle, on a length. Liam Livingstone flicks it in front of square leg for a single. He is off the mark.
The centurion of the first match, Liam Livingstone walks out to bat at No.5.

OUT! CAUGHT! Moeen Ali departs now after an entertaining innings! A touch fuller ball, slanting across, outside off. Ali doesn't hit it hard, just chips it over mid off. Babar Azam takes two three steps back and completes the catch with ease. England now 3 down. Moeen Ali was looking brilliant today but has to depart. He goes back after a well made 36 off just 16 balls.
Commentary.Howout: c Babar Azam b Mohammad Hasnain

Commentary.Commentary: Good length ball on middle. Buttler works it to long on for a single.
On the pads, flicked to deep mid-wicket for one run.
WIDE! A pacy short ball on middle. Ali sits under it. Wide called for height.
A short of a length ball outside off. Buttler slashes it to deep point for a single.
Mohammad Hasnain is back into the attack. Conceded 19 runs in his first over.
Weather - Though there were heavy rains here last week, it has been looking bright as of now and we should probably have another belter of a deck.

SIX! Bread and butter stuff for Moeen Ali! Pitches it up, on middle, in the arc and it was asking to be hit. Ali slog sweeps it over mid-wicket for a biggie. Another big over for England, 15 coming off it.
FOUR! Pulled away! A short ball on middle. Ali swivels across and pulls it to mid-wicket for a boundary.
Another tossed up ball outside off. Buttler works it to deep cover for a single.
Tossed up, on middle. Buttler steps out and pushes it wide of long off for a couple of runs.
Flatter ball on middle. Ali whips it to deep mid-wicket for a single. Brings up the 50-run partnership off just 24 balls.
Full on middle. Pushed to sweeper cover for a single.
Shadab Khan is brought into the attack.

FOUR! That is straight off the middle! A full ball outside off. Ali leans into his drive and creams it through cover-point for a boundary. 19 runs coming of this over. End of the Powerplay, England are 66 for 2.
FOUR! Not quite of the middle but enough for it to race away! A full ball way outside off. Ali drags it across towards mid-wicket fence.
WIDE! Have to reload this! A bumper, just around off. Ali watches it sail over him. Wided.
Full ball on middle. Buttler pushes it to right of mid on for a single.
On the pads, clipped away to square leg for one.
FOUR! Just beautiful! A full ball outside off. Ali drives it through covers for a boundary. Straightaway puts pressure on Haris Rauf.
FOUR! Moeen Ali gets to the party and welcomes Haris Rauf with a boundary! A back of a length ball, outside off. Ali cuts it past point for a boundary.
Haris Rauf comes into the attack.

FOUR! Buttler is on a mission! Full and outside off, Jos Buttler sees the width and takes the advantage of it. Slashes it out past the diving point fielder for another boundary. 19 runs from the over.
FOUR! More runs for Buttler! Length ball on off, Jos Buttler rocks back and steers it past backward point for another boundary. Beautiful to see that. Moves onto 24 now.
SIX! Buttler and his innovative shots! Length ball on off, Jos Buttler gets into the line of the ball. He paddle scoops it over the keeper's head for a maximum.
On the pads, Ali tucks it towards deep square leg for one.
FOUR! Do not give room to this guy! Length ball outside off, Moeen Ali flashes it past point for a boundary.
Serves a length ball on off, Ali steers it towards point.
Mohammad Hasnain is into the attack now.
Short of a length on middle, Buttler pushes it to left of the bowler. 5 runs from it.
Length ball on off, Buttler punches it to mid off.
On a length on off, pushed back to the bowler.
FOUR! Class written all over that! Good length ball on off, Jos Buttler punches it off the front foot through point for a boundary.
On a length on off, Ali taps it towards point and calls for a single.
Short ball on middle, Ali sits under it.
FOUR! Good end to the over! Full and outside off, Jos Buttler reaches out for it and drives it through cover-point for a boundary.
Loopy ball on middle, Buttler blocks it out.
On off, Ali drills it to mid on for one.
Moeen Ali is the new man in.

OUT! TAKEN! Imad Wasim gets another! Tossed up on middle, Dawid Malan goes on his knee and sweeps but miscues it. The ball goes off the outside edge and lobs up in the air towards short third man. Azam Khan takes a dolly over there. End of Malan's stay. Pakistan are all over England here.
Commentary.Howout: c Azam Khan b Imad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Flatter ball on off, Malan knocks it in front of point.
Loopy ball on middle, Buttler clips it to mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length on middle, Buttler dabs it to backward point. He keeps the strike taking a single. 6 runs from the over.
On a length on middle, Buttler defends it watchfully.
FOUR! Textbook cover-drive! Full and on off, Jos Buttler leans into it, watches the ball closely and creams it through the covers for a boundary.
A slip in place for Jos Buttler.
Back of a length on middle and leg, Malan plays it towards mid-wicket for one. He gets off the mark.
Ohh, so close! Length delivery around off, seaming in. Malan looks to defend but misses. The ball was whisker away from hitting the off pole.
Back of a length delivery on off, 134kph, Malan taps it towards point.
Shaheen Afridi will bowl from the other end.
Floated it up outside off, Butter drills it towards covers. What a start for Pakistan. 11 runs from the over but got the important wicket of Roy.
Quicker delivery on middle, Buttler blocks it out.

OUT! TAKEN! Imad Wasim has the last laugh! Pitches it a bit slow on middle, Jason Roy goes for another big shot. He makes room for himself, shuffles down the leg side and heaves it over point. Didn't quite middle it though and Mohammad Hafeez completes the catch with ease. Imad Wasim draws the first blood and it is the priced wicket of Jason Roy. He was looking dangerous but Wasim has sent him back.
Commentary.Howout: c Mohammad Hafeez b Imad Wasim

Commentary.Commentary: Who will walk out to bat now? It is Dawid Malan.
WIDE! Down the leg side. Roy misses his sweep. Wided.
FOUR! Classic! Full and on middle, Jason Roy gets on his knee and sweeps it towards deep square leg for a boundary. That went in a flash!
SIX! Welcome into the attack Imad Wasim! Flatter delivery on middle, Jason Roy makes room for himself and sails this one into the crowd for the first maximum. England and Jason Roy are underway!
Full and quicker on off, Roy pushes it towards mid off.

We are set to begin! The Pakistan players form a huddle and make their way out in the middle. Jason Roy and Jos Buttler to open the innings for England. Imad Wasim to start with the ball. Here we go...

England (Playing XI) - Jason Roy, Jos Buttler (C/WK) (IN PLACE OF EOIN MORGAN), Dawid Malan, Moeen Ali, Liam Livingstone, Jonny Bairstow, Tom Curran, Chris Jordan (IN PLACE OF DAVID WILLEY), Adil Rashid (IN PLACE OF LEWIS GREGORY), Saqib Mahmood, Matthew Parkinson.
Pakistan (Playing XI) -  Mohammad Rizwan (WK), Babar Azam (C), Sohaib Maqsood, Fakhar Zaman, Mohammad Hafeez, Azam Khan, Imad Wasim, Shadab Khan, Shaheen Afridi, Haris Rauf, Mohammad Hasnain.
TOSS time at Headingley! Up goes the coin and lands in the favor of Pakistan. They have elected to BOWL first.
There is news from the England camp that Jos Buttler will captain the England side as Eoin Morgan has rested himself.

Pakistan might not tinker with their winning combination as a victory will give them a series win. After the carnage in Nottingham, Mohammad Rizwan will continue to open alongside his skipper, Babar Azam with Fakhar Zaman and Mohammad Hafeez in the middle order.

England are set to make changes and it is likely that Adil Rashid and Chris Jordan who were rested will return for this match. Jos Buttler has recovered from his calf injury too and the head coach Paul Collingwood confirmed that he will be back in the playing 11 which could mean either David Malan or Johny Bairstow might be given a rest.

For those who haven't checked it out yet, the 2021 T20 World Cup schedule has been announced and some mouth-watering matches await us. England are in Group 1 which can be termed as the 'Group of Death' with Australia, West Indies, and South Africa in the same group. Pakistan finds themselves in Group 2 and they will clash against India along with New Zealand and Afghanistan.

Time for Round 2! After a high-scoring run spree, England and Pakistan will again battle out in the second T20I. Pakistan ticked all the boxes in the first match. They will be desperate to carry on the winning momentum. For Morgan and Co. the match is a must-win affair to level the series 1-1. Is another high-scoring encounter on the cards? Will Pakistan win and seal the series? Or will England bounce back? Too many questions which will be answered shortly. Toss and lineups in a bit.
